title: Seacrest 166 Blue Crab Rosemary Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewSpacious Newer Home, Beautifully Decorated - 3 bikes & Tram Service- -Community Lagoon Pool-Private Beach - `Blue Crab Beach House`The Space Blue Crab Beach House – Private Seacrest Retreat Near Rosemary & Alys Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Walking Distance to Rosemary & Alys Beach – Prime location in Seacrest Beach 3 Adult Bikes Included – Explore scenic trails & nearby coastal towns Private Lot with Wooded Backyard – Endless views of the nature preserve Multiple Porches for Relaxation – Enjoy peaceful outdoor seating & fresh air 2-Minute Walk to the Lagoon Pool – 12,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool just steps away Quick Walk to the Beach Tram Stop – Convenient transportation to the beach Spacious & Stylish Coastal Interiors – Hardwood floors, shiplap walls & natural light Fully Stocked Kitchen – Utensils, cookware, blenders, & coffee makers included Outdoor Shower & Powder Room – Perfect for rinsing off after a beach day Two Master Suites – Each with en-suite bath & private porch access Quintessential Bunk Room – Fun & cozy space for kids or extra guests Driveway Parking for 3 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to Blue Crab Beach HouseBlue Crab Beach House is one of Seacrest Beach's most private homes with a backyard full of nature preserve that lends itself to picturesque views of the forest from its multiple porch spaces and no backyard neighbors. This exceptional location is just a 2-3min walk to the 12,000 sq/ft lagoon pool, directly next to one of the tram stops that shuttles you to and from the beach. Just 5mins to Rosemary, 5mins to Alys Beach, and ideally borders one of Seacrest's nature trails, so your morning walks can begin and end just a few steps off the back porch.This home greets you with wonderful southern coastal charm and curb appeal with its beach cottage style, well-manicured landscaping, and beautiful craftsmanship displayed in the detail of the porch railings and the exposed rafters. This home is accented with hardwood plank floors, vertical shiplap accent walls, coastal decor, and abundant natural light throughout.There is a fully-stocked kitchen with utensils, cookware, blenders, coffee makers. There is a powder room off the living room and an outdoor shower just out the home's separate entrance off the kitchen. The master is also located on the main floor with private access to the front porch. Upstairs there are 2 additional bedrooms, one 2nd master with ensuite bath and private porch access. The 3rd additional guest suite is currently set-up as the quintessential bunk room with ensuite bath.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.*SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10):Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private en suite bath, private front porchGuest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, en suite bathroom with private porch accessBunk Room: Two sets of twin bunk beds, en suite bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
